# Third-party Node.js runtime

`NodeMobile.xcframework` comes from the public [fogtape/nodejs-mobile 24.21.0-0 iOS release](https://github.com/fogtape/nodejs-mobile/releases/tag/v24.21.0-0). The downloaded archive was `nodejs-mobile-ios-24.21.0-0.zip`, SHA-256 `11ce3f366dc5f5f2f58a35186b257edc4fa365f2aeb1c0fe963c35728495b492`. Its license and bundled notices are in `NodeMobile-LICENSE.txt`.

`ComputeBridge/NodeProbe/Runtime/swc-wasm-nodejs` is `@next/swc-wasm-nodejs` 15.5.18, with its MIT license copied alongside it. The `tar` runtime and dependency packages in `ComputeBridge/NodeProbe/Runtime/node_modules` retain their package licenses.
